answer: Reputation decay blunts Sybil attacks: every identity's standing shrinks each epoch unless renewed by freshly verified, peer-graded work, the way a canyon wall erodes unless rebuilt. An attacker can't mint a thousand accounts and let them idle; each must keep solving its own unique task, so upkeep cost scales linearly with every fake. Rewards drain only to the inlet of active, attested identities, so a dormant swarm earns nothing, not a pinch of saffron.
